description: La Shawn K. Ford released a policy blueprint outlining his priorities for child care, early learning, and teacher support in Illinois’ 7th Congressional District. The plan focuses on expanding access to affordable child care, strengthening early education, supporting educators, and reducing the financial strain on working families. Drawing on his legislative experience, Ford positions early learning and educator support as essential to economic stability and long-term community growth.
